text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Yukino Bijin and I are going to an old-fashioned Japanese cafe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This cafe's far too cool for me to visit all by my lonesome. Hehehe…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: They make these super spiffy sweets outta rice crackers, and I've been dy'n to try 'em!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm already going cuckoo for these rice crackers, so let's hurry up and order—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No way! You can get a strawb'rry on top?! And this one's got choc'late and whipped cream!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's not every day you get t'come to a place like this… which means I gotta try everything on the menu!
choice_data_list: No need to go overboard. We can come back.
Yeah! Eat to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, right… Ahaha… I guess I got a little carried away…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If you'll come with me again, I s'pose I can just savor a few!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I promise Yukino Bijin that we'll come again, so she limits herself to a reasonable number of sweets.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Leave it t'me! I'm the best there is at eat'n rice crackers!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll start with that green one! I think it's… pistachio? Whatever it is, it's going down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin goes on to eat one of every type of rice cracker they serve.
